resources.string: Sign in to start a family
A family shares grocery lists, recipe books, and a meal plan across everyone’s devices, so it needs an account.
You’re not in a family yet
Create one to share grocery lists, recipe books, and a meal plan with the people you cook for. Everyone you invite can add and edit what’s shared.
Couldn’t create the family. Check your connection and try again.
You’re already in a family. Leave it first to join or create another.
Couldn’t rename the family. Check your connection and try again.
Couldn’t send that invite. Check the address and your connection.
They’ll get an email and an in-app notification. Nothing is shared until they accept.
{email} will lose access to everything shared with the family.
You’ll lose access to the grocery lists, recipe books, and meal plan shared with the family. Anything you created stays yours.
Everyone loses access to what the family shares. Each person keeps the lists, books, and recipes they created.
That didn’t go through. Check your connection and try again.
